rules.sectionReferenceMeaning: Use the accepted Latin Niese registry. XVI–XVII use its explicit anchored physical spans, with XVI split sections grouped only for Boolean scope. XVIII–XIX combine actual Niese milestones with explicitly adopted paragraph/element starts. XX honors its partial XX.26 end target. Unavailable identities create no synthetic records.
rules.textTransformations: Exclude marked labels, notes, headings, trailers and front matter. Three literal XVI [...] notices outside accepted intervals and the inherited XX annotation between its accepted XX.26 end and XX.37 start are excluded reversibly. Retain all other source characters, including untagged Roman chapter letters and add/del/unclear/corr/expan content. Trim physical paragraph-fragment edges and join continuing paragraphs with two newlines.
rules.phraseBoundaries: Exact phrases follow the physical source sequence and cannot jump between displaced fragments. Actual TEI gaps and literal dotted interruptions block adjacency. The explicit excluded notices between XVI.188 and 200 and XX.26 and 37 also block adjacency; skipped registry identities alone do not.
rules.editorialMarkup: Preserve exact add/del/unclear attributes and UTF-16 spans in editorialMarks; corr/expan/s/ref appear in sourceMarkup. Do not silently correct readings, omit marginal source words, or generate display glyphs.
rules.unknownContent: Require the frozen accepted XML and identity-registry hashes, with CRLF/LF equivalence. A changed source, unresolved boundary, overlapping interval, lost running character or unreviewed empty span stops extraction.
rules.sourceProjectionDefinition: Each original narrative paragraph is exactly restored from finished recordId slices plus excluded labels/notes and reversible edge whitespace. Anonymous paragraphs use an explicit xpath: source locator, never an invented XML id.
rules.offsetDefinition: Audit sourceText, flat and recordText coordinates are Python Unicode characters, end exclusive. Published inline marks, textGaps and phraseBreaks use JavaScript UTF-16 offsets.
rules.tokenCountDefinition: Unicode L/N start and L/M/N continuation, with explicit source gaps interrupting token formation. The accepted XVII.41–42 milestone separates eleuati and cum without an intervening source space; this precisely audited section boundary separates search tokens and preserves whole-book phrase adjacency.
rules.readerRoute: /antiquities/?book=16&niese={section}; split XVI sections display their accepted physical portions in witness order.

excluded.text: Quem ammodum alexander et artistobolus reuersi de roma ad suum patrem et ad salomi uel ferora regis frates accusabant eos.
II Qualiter herodes alexandro uel aristobolo uxoribus datis ad agrippam in mitilene nauigauit inuitans eum ad iudaea uenire et profectio agrippe ad oniam.
III Vt herodes secundo nauigauit ad agrippam in bossoro.
IIII Interpellatio iudaeorum ad agrippam in onia praesente herode de quibus graecos accusabant.
V Quem ammodum confirmauit eis leges herodes autem ad propria rediit.
VI Qualiter allocutus est herodes hierosolimitas  et quartam partem eis fiscalium praeteriti anni concessit.
VII Vt pertubatio domus herodis facta est pro honore antipatri prioris filii moleste ferente alexandro.
VIII Quem ammodum antipatro romae commorante alexandrum herodis ad caesarem deducens accusauit.
VIIII De alexandri satisfactione coram caesarem et reconciliatione cum patre.
X Quem ammodum celebrauit quinquennale certamen herodis in honore caesaris et legatio cirinensium et asianorum iudaeorum ad caesarem de his quae iudaeos accusabant.
XI Exemplar caesaris epistule et agrippe quas pro ipsis ciuitabus scripserunt.
XII Quem ammodum egens herodes pecuniis descendit ad sepulchrum dauid et terrore imaginum territus tumulum de super statuit.
XIII Vt archelaus rex cappadociae reconciliauit alexandrum patri ligatum ab eo ut ipse ad cappadociam herodes autem romae profectus est.
XIIII Discessio habitantium trachonem a regno herodis et uastatio per duces eius.
XV Qualiter herodes a roma reuersus in arabia transfugas postulabat, cumque non obtinuisset exercitum contra eos produxit reuerso saturnino duce.
XVI Quem ammodum silleus accusauit coram caesarem herodem de incursione quam in arabia fecerat.
XVII Criminationes eureclei contra filios ad patrem herodem et quia ligasset eos pater et ad caesarem scripsisse.
XVIII Vt per nicolaum accusatione liberatus est irato caesare
XVIIII Qualiter caesare potestatem praebente concilio in berito accusauit filios herodes.
XX Mors iuuenum et sepultura corporum eorum in alexandria
Bamberg Msc. Class. 78
